name: CBHB
recent: CBH Engineering 于 2026 年 11 月 18 日宣布获得价值 RM51m 的吉兰丹大型太阳能项目合约，并公布季度业绩创下新高。此前公司股价在数据中心相关合约消息后走高，交易所曾于 11 月 13 日暂停其即日卖空。董事 Cheah Boon Hwa 在 9 月至 10 月间多次申报增持股份。
notable: 获得价值 RM51m 的吉兰丹大型太阳能项目合约。
董事 Cheah Boon Hwa 在 9 月至 10 月间多次增持公司股份。
risks: Bursa Malaysia 于 2026 年 11 月 13 日暂停 CBH Engineering 股票的即日卖空。
董事在闭门期前申报有意交易股份，随后在闭门期内进行交易。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM120.9m，环比增长 35.1%，同比增长 102.6%；净利为 RM24.5m，环比增长 34.9%，同比增长 142.7%；净利率为 20.3%，与上季度持平。

recent_en: On 18 November 2026, CBH Engineering announced a RM51m large-scale solar project contract in Kelantan and reported record-high quarterly results. Earlier, the share price rose after data centre-related contract wins, and Bursa Malaysia suspended intraday short selling of the shares on 13 November. Director Cheah Boon Hwa filed multiple notices of share acquisitions between September and October.
notable_en: Secured a RM51m large-scale solar project contract in Kelantan.
Reported a record-high quarterly net profit.
Director Cheah Boon Hwa acquired shares in the company multiple times between September and October.
risks_en: Bursa Malaysia suspended intraday short selling of CBH Engineering shares on 13 November 2026.
A director notified intention to deal during the closed period and subsequently traded within the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM120.9m, up 35.1% QoQ and 102.6% YoY; net profit was RM24.5m, up 34.9% QoQ and 142.7% YoY; net margin was 20.3%, unchanged from the previous quarter.
